title: Zetta-Joule heat chart
description: A dark band with a split heading and a tabbed horizontal bar chart on a dotted-grid axis: dashed floating ranges per tab (what each industry needs), a sky-blue bar for your product with the wordmark inside, and four dark comparison bars with a blue end marker. Tabs have a 4px blue underline and a 0.2s colour hover; on phones the tabs become a select box and the chart scrolls sideways with a slider beneath.
notes: bar lengths come from the numbers, so any unit works (set unit, axisMax, axisStep)
needs JavaScript for the tabs and slider
name: zetta-joule-heat
